urn:eigenius:core:description: EIG_0042 vs CDK2 (Kinase-Glo): IC50 = 42 nM bounded by the result's reported 95% CI [38, 47] nM. Demonstrates the v1 sanity-bound use of BoundedBy — the institution validates `inf <= value <= sup` on commit and admits the resource if so. Decidable role lets a downstream program use Exp::NativeDecide(BoundedBy(ic50_value, [lo, hi]), _) to reduce to Refl when the bound holds.

Selectivity index of EIG_0042 (IC50_CDK4 / IC50_CDK2). Point estimate 380/42 ~= 9.05; interval-propagated bound [320/47, 450/38] = [6.81, 11.84] obtained by IntervalArithmetic.jl on the per-target CI bounds. AutoOnLoad validates `inf <= value <= sup`.

For the kinase-activity-remaining function h(c) = K/(K+c) parameterised at K = IC50 = 42 nM (EIG_0042 vs CDK2), bound the function on the assay's compound-concentration range c in [0, 1000] nM. h is monotonically decreasing, so h([0, 1000]) = [h(1000), h(0)] = [42/1042, 1] = [0.04031, 1.0]. The institution's interval extension reproduces this on commit.
